list.item:
General:
Decision of the United States to participate in the Middle East Supply Center
Exchange of notes between the United States and the United Kingdom regarding air services in the Near and Middle East
Concern of the United States at the impact of Axis victories and propaganda on the political stability of the Near East; dispatch of the Hoskins Mission
Consideration by the Department of State of proposal to appoint American representative as counterpart of British Minister Resident in West Africa

Afghanistan:
Establishment of an American Legation in Afghanistan
Efforts by the United States to effect closer relations with Afghanistan
Expression of regret by the United States regarding the accidental flight of an American Army plane over Afghan territory

Egypt:
Unwillingness of the United States to interfere with British activities concerning Egyptian political crisis
Concern of the United States regarding effect of Axis military advance into Egypt; plans for evacuation of American diplomatic and consular personnel from Egypt
Problems arising from presence in Egypt of American military personnel: Post-war demobilization and criminal jurisdiction
Representations by the Egyptian Government regarding effect on Egyptian cotton trade of reciprocal trade agreement between the United States and Peru
Representations by the Egyptian Minister regarding an article in Time alleged to be derogatory to the King of Egypt

Ethiopia:
Consideration by the Department of State of the resumption of diplomatic representation in Ethiopia
Exchange of messages between President Roosevelt and the Emperor of Ethiopia (Haile Selassie I); adherence of Ethiopia to the United Nations Declaration
Representations by the United States regarding certain exclusive features of the Anglo-Ethiopian Treaty of January 31, 1942

Iran:
Concern of the United States regarding danger of food shortages in Iran threatening famine and internal disorder:
I. Participation of the United States in decisions regarding supply and distribution of food for Iran
II. Iranian appeals for direct American aid; complaints by Iranians and by American Minister in Iran concerning British economic policies in Iran
III. Negotiation of agreement between the United States, the United Kingdom, and Iran regarding food supply for Iran, signed December 4, 1942
IV. Representations by the United States regarding British policy in Iran
Assistance by the United States in securing for the Iranian Government American advisers (military, financial, police, gendarmerie, etc.)
Reservation of American rights regarding certain provisions of Anglo-Soviet-Iranian Treaty of Alliance; unwillingness of the United States to make declaration concerning integrity of Iran
Negotiations respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Iran
Extension of Lend-Lease aid to Iran and desire of Iran to deal directly with the United States in Lend-Lease matters
Efforts of the United States to facilitate a settlement of the dispute between the United Kingdom and Iran regarding exchange rates
Agreement with the United Kingdom for American operation of the southern section of the Trans-Iranian Railroad and conditional consent of the Iranian Government
Concern of the United States regarding Kurdish disorders in Soviet-occupied province of Azerbaijan
Insistence by the United States that the Japanese Legation be expelled from Iran
Iranian request for American support in regard to British demands for arrest of certain suspected persons in Iran

Iraq:
Announcement of Iraq’s eligibility for Lend-Lease aid; procedures for effecting Lend-Lease aid to Iraq
Insistence by the United States that American war materials sent to or through Iraq be exempt from Iraqi customs and transit dues
Unwillingness of the United States to request exemption for Americans from Iraqi residence tax

Liberia:
Defense agreement and arrangements between the United States and Liberia
Extension of Lend-Lease aid to Liberia by the United States
Discussions regarding British proposal for use of American air bases in Liberia
Insistence by the United States on the expulsion of Germans from Liberia
Negotiations concerning the replacement of British currency in Liberia by American currency

Morocco:
Negotiations between the American Chargé at Tangier and the Spanish High Commissioner regarding American economic aid to Spanish Zone of Morocco and Tangier
Informal cooperation between the Diplomatic Agency and Spanish authorities regarding taxes and price controls in the Tangier Zone without prejudice to American treaty rights
Representations by the United States regarding attempts by the Spanish customs officials at Tangier to open official packages addressed to the American Legation
Policies and actions of the United States regarding Spanish Morocco in connection with the invasion of French North Africa by American forces

Muscat and Oman:
Negotiations concerning use by the United States of air bases in Muscat and Oman

Palestine:
Attitude of the United States toward Zionist and Arab agitation regarding British policy in the Middle East and the future status of Palestine

Saudi Arabia:
Establishment of an American Legation at Jidda
American agricultural mission to Saudi Arabia
Negotiations regarding air transit rights over certain parts of Saudi Arabia for American planes
Consideration by the United States of means for protection of oil fields in Saudi Arabia and for denying the enemy the use of them

Syria and Lebanon:
Concern of the United States regarding British-Free French differences in Syria and Lebanon; attempts to effect settlement
Limited recognition of Syria and Lebanon by the United States by the appointment of a Diplomatic Agent

Turkey:
Negotiations regarding handling of Lend-Lease supplies for Turkey
Policy of the United States regarding the pre-emptive buying of Turkish goods
Favorable response by the United States to Turkish requests for additional wheat
Efforts by the American and British Governments to acquire Turkish chrome and to prevent its sale by Turkey to Germany
Expression of regret by the United States for the landing of American bombers on neutral Turkish territory; internment of planes and crews; escape of one plane and crew
Representations by the United States regarding application of Straits Convention to passage of Axis vessels through Straits
Clarification of statement by Ambassador Mac Murray regarding Turkish-Soviet relations
Willingness of the United States to assist in the improvement of relations between the Soviet Union and Turkey; explanation of Turkish-Soviet relations by the Turkish Foreign Minister
Misuse by the Soviet Government of information furnished by the United States regarding the attempted assassination of German Ambassador von Papen in Ankara
Representations by the United States regarding taxation of American colleges in Turkey
